_comment: 39-I: Cross-domain Synthesis. How findings from different specialist domains compose.

_cross_domain_inputs.description: Synthesise findings from mathematics (A), statistics (E), and CS/software (F) specialists.
checks: Software tool findings (F) aligned with mathematical model (A)
Unified finding severity calibration across domains

_convergence_criteria.description: Converges when: cross-domain synthesis produces stable composite view.
_convergence_criteria.primary: gamma >= 0.40 AND 0 unresolved cross-domain contradictions for 2 rounds
_convergence_criteria.secondary: 3+ rounds with no new cross-domain finding
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Unresolved contradictions between domain outputs at wall clock cap
